text:
Samir Patel: quick sync - follow-up to the residency RFC: we need a pragmatic handshake between edge proxy and regional runtime to avoid routing races during capacity changes. current idea: short-lived route leases (client_id + lease_id + expiry) returned by region controller. thoughts?
Leah Gomez: route leases sound promising. want to understand failure modes: what if lease expires mid-request? we can't re-route an inflight request.
Anna Chen: we already use request-level routing tokens for debugging. Lease expiry should be checked only at start of request. if it expires mid-request, runtime continues serving. we should document that invariant.
Miguel Torres: how are leases obtained? on each incoming connection the proxy queries control-plane -> adds latency. prefer cache-on-proxy with TTL and async refresh.
Samir Patel: yes, proxy caches per-tenant lease for TTL=30s, and refreshes in background at 70% TTL. If cache miss, synchronous call with 25ms budget.
Leah Gomez: what about sequential retries? If proxy thinks lease expired and fetch fails, it might send to fallback region. Could cause transient split-brain for writes. We need a simple fencing token in the lease to make writes idempotent across regions.
Anna Chen: propose lease token includes monotonically increasing epoch and a signature: tenant_id|epoch|lease_id|sig. Runtimes refuse writes with older epoch. That gives fencing.
Miguel Torres: signing requires KMS integration. ops-bot: note: ksm-rotation-2026-03 scheduled; ensure design tolerates key rotation.
Samir Patel: agree. Implementation sketch: control-plane issues lease {lease_id, epoch, expires_at, signed_token}. Proxy includes header X-Route-Lease: <signed_token> in requests. Data-plane verifies token signature & epoch against last-seen epoch for that tenant. If epoch < last_seen -> 409 Conflict.
Leah Gomez: 409 is good for preventing split-writes. But clients may expect a retry path. We should document recommended retry: backoff + refetch lease.
Anna Chen: we should also add a fast-path: if tenant is configured prefer_failover=true, on 409 the proxy can automatically fetch new lease and retry once (sync). make it opt-in.
Miguel Torres: metrics we need: lease_fetch_latency, lease_refresh_failures, write_fenced_conflicts, lease_retry_success. ops-bot: metric: lease_refresh_failures increased by 7% during last canary.
Samir Patel: security: signed token must not leak PII; token contains tenant_id but that's fine. logs must redact signed_token. Add header X-Route-Lease-Src for observability when proxy used cached vs fresh.
Leah Gomez: rollout plan: 1) control-plane issues unsigned leases for proxy-only testing, 2) data-plane accepts unsigned and signed for a window, 3) turn on signing enforcement. need a migration window and feature flag.
Anna Chen: API surface: header name X-Route-Lease, X-Route-Lease-Src (cache|fresh), X-Residency-Decision maybe combined with earlier residency header. Example request:
```
POST /v1/complete
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <tok>
X-Residency: prefer
X-Route-Lease: tenant123|42|lid-7f2|sig-zzzz
```
Response behavior: 409 on fenced write attempt with body {"error":"lease_conflict","hint":"refetch_lease"}.
Miguel Torres: CI: add integ test that simulates parallel writers with staggered lease expiry and asserts one wins and the other 409s, and that proxy retry path works when prefer_failover=true.
ops-bot: task-created: integ/leases/parallel-write-fence added to ci with tag lease-fencing.
Samir Patel: one more: when proxy falls back to remote region due to local evictions, should it proactively attempt to obtain a lease from remote? I think yes, but with strict timeout (50ms). Otherwise proxy can add metadata header X-Fallback-Reason: local-capacity.
Leah Gomez: agree. Also we must document that any 409 must never have caused durable side-effects in the losing region. guarantee at runtime: apply-on-commit after epoch verification.
Anna Chen: good catch. We'll add requirement: runtimes must validate lease token before mutating state. If token invalid -> reject before any side-effects.
Miguel Torres: ops notes: add dashboard panel for per-region lease-age distribution and a heatmap for refetch latencies.
Samir Patel: ok actionable list: Anna write spec + examples + migration steps; Miguel add metrics/dashboards and CI tests; Leah update runtime invariants doc; I'll prototype control-plane lease signer.
Anna Chen: will send draft spec by EOD Tues.
Leah Gomez: +1. small nit: make TTL configurable per-tenant; high-compliance tenants want shorter TTLs.
Samir Patel: yep expose lease_ttl in tenant profile. default 30s.
Anna Chen: ack. :thumbsup:
Miguel Torres: :thumbsup:
